note: Harbor Counting House settings. Rates are percent per season. Interest is added once when the season changes. Coins are whole numbers.
banker_lines: Welcome to the Harbor Counting House. Your coins are safe with us.
Saved coins grow a little every season. Lira of the Quiet Purse would approve.
They say the Pale Ledger would love to buy this house. We are not for sale.
Some old depositors seem to live a very long time. Interest adds up for them.
The Aureate Compact and House Vesperine are quarreling again. Just a rumor, of course.
Pop bugs with Lux and the town pays a few coins for each one.
